source.title: Crafting Work Orders are Here - Economy Weekly Wrap-Up 251 (milling beta original quote)
source.author: SamadanPlaysWoW quoting Liqourice5

quote: Milled 2,000 herbs (400 craft actions,) had 60 left over.
notes: Numerical gap audit, not an empirical material-drop study. NEW independent client-build-backed rank map from TheWoWDB: Serevite Ore [190395=R1;190396=R2;190394=R3]; Draconium Ore [189143=R1;188658=R2;190311=R3]; Khaz'gorite Ore [190312=R1;190313=R2;190314=R3]; Saxifrage [191464=R1;191465=R2;191466=R3]; Bubble Poppy [191467=R1;191468=R2;191469=R3]; Eternity Amber [192849=R1;192850=R2;192851=R3]; Illimited Diamond [192869=R1;192870=R2;192871=R3]. TheWoWDB says ranks are read from World of Warcraft client build files (site currently displays Retail 12.1.5.70783); this verifies present item identity, NOT retrospective 2022 study build or output rates. Queue T0015's Aary R2 Saxifrage study cannot correspond to item 191464 (R1); R2 is 191465. Superbondez's 4 reported rank-3 Eternity Amber units / 80 already-indexed completed Prismatic Ore 194545 prospects map by item identity to rank3 item 192851, but original family-level study and unresolved per-output hits should not be copied or promoted without Master review. A previously unrecorded source-side 2022-10-22 beta milling Resourcefulness test reproduced by Wowhead on 2022-10-30 reports 400 craft actions, 2,000 stated herbs and 60 left over, with player Resourcefulness 12.6%; its original Reddit author post is deleted. This is INPUT-SAVINGS context only (not 60 pigment units, 400 per-pigment denominator, or current-patch rate), recipe x5, herb ranks and pigment totals/IDs are unknown. Prior 2-5 pigments per mill beta references remain non-measured guides, not new independent output samples. No new public original per-material castsWithDrop, 0/1/2+ histogram or rank/skill-matched current processing sample found.
lookingFor: Original Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling per-output completed-cast numeric histograms; independently verifiable exact quality-rank identities
whereLooked: TheWoWDB item name-first pages for Serevite, Draconium, Khaz'gorite, Saxifrage, Bubble Poppy, Eternity Amber and Illimited Diamond: client-build quality ranks, no prospect/mill event samples.

Wowhead named original Dragonflight milling discussion quoted in the 2022-10-30 Economy Weekly Wrap-Up #251: found 400 2022 beta milling craft actions, 2,000 nominal input herbs, 60 leftover, player Resourcefulness 12.6%; material output per-cast histogram absent.

Reddit r/woweconomy original 'A Look at Dragonflight Milling' by Liqourice5 (https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/yaxw94): original OP deleted; do not duplicate 2022 beta 2-5 pigment reference, no original event-level output table accessible.

GitHub t-mart/wow-auction README Serevite Ore quality ID mapping search: independent software example lists 190395 R1/190396 R2/190394 R3; no processing sample or cast ledger (https://github.com/t-mart/wow-auction/blob/master/README.md).
GoldCap named Saxifrage rank pages 191464,191465,191466 and Serevite 190396: earlier secondary corroboration only; no original processing cast-by-cast observations.
WoWPriceHub Serevite and Saxifrage named item market pages: secondary rank mapping, not source-original per-cast distributions.
Warcraft Wiki Prismatic Ore and Dragon Isles Prospecting named pages: unlock/recipe data, no new output 0/1/2+ study.
Wowhead named Dragon Isles Prospecting and Writhebark/Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage originals: previous Bugy/Aary original study lineage, not independent fresh output cohort.
